comments.author: @ParadoxTravel
comments.text: Phenomenal look beyond the tourist postcards! The detail that hits hardest is how blackouts don't just mean sitting in the dark—they cut off the water pumps, forcing families in aging Havana solares to haul buckets up steep stairs while racing to cook before food spoils. True human resilience in the face of a 75% public transit collapse.
